name: Wild Symbiosis
source: Homebrew — table house rule, not real 5e Circle of the Moon text. Also modeled in engine/data/subclasses/druid-circle-of-the-moon.json for level-up tooling.
description: While in Wild Shape, a Circle of the Moon druid retains the numerical bonuses from equipped magic gear made of natural, organically-originated materials — wood, cloth, leather, bone, antler, horn, shell, pearl, coral, amber, woven plant fiber, or Vixivirite (see materials.json) — or from any item that explicitly states it functions in Wild Shape. Mined/cut minerals and gemstones (diamond, ruby, sapphire, crystal, jade, obsidian, etc.), worked metal armor, and metal weapons never qualify, consistent with existing druid tradition around avoiding worked metal. Qualifying AC bonuses apply directly to the beast form's AC. Qualifying weapon attack/damage bonuses apply directly to the beast's attack and damage rolls, representing the magic empowering the druid's natural weapons even though nothing is physically wielded. Other item effects — activated abilities, granted spells, utility properties — still require their normal trigger and don't function while shapeshifted unless the item explicitly states otherwise.
notes: Adopted because this campaign runs gear-forward itemization rather than feat/subclass-forward power, and Wild Shape's flat stat-block numbers otherwise fall behind as the rest of the party's gear scales. Restricted to Circle of the Moon since that subclass's identity depends on Wild Shape staying combat-relevant, unlike circles built around spellcasting.

name: Infuse Item
description: At the end of a long rest, touch nonmagical objects and infuse them with magic. Each infusion can only be in one object at a time. If you try to exceed your infusion limit, the oldest infusion ends. An infusion remains in an item indefinitely, but when you die, it vanishes after a number of days equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1 day). Number of infusions known and active scale with artificer level.

name: Magic Item Adept
description: You can attune to up to 4 magic items at once. If you craft a magic item that is a common or uncommon item, it takes you a quarter of the normal time and costs half as much gold.

name: Eldritch Cannon
uses_note: One free creation per long rest. You can create additional cannons beyond that at any time by expending a spell slot for each one — not limited by a flat charge pool.
description: Using woodcarver's tools or smith's tools in hand, use your action to create a magical cannon in an unoccupied space on a horizontal surface within 5ft of you. Once you create a cannon this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a spell slot to create another. The cannon is a magical object of size Small or Tiny that has AC 18 and HP equal to 5 times your artificer level. It is immune to poison and psychic damage. It disappears if it is reduced to 0hp or after 1 hour. As a bonus action, you can command the cannon to activate if you are within 60ft of it. It disappears when you create another — you can have only one cannon at a time until Fortified Position at 15th level. Choose one of three modes when creating:

modes.name: Flamethrower
modes.description: 15ft cone. Each creature makes DEX save or takes 2d8 fire damage, half on success. Ignites unattended flammable objects.

modes.name: Force Ballista
modes.description: Ranged spell attack using your spell attack modifier. Range 120ft. On hit: 2d8 force damage and target pushed 5ft away.

modes.name: Protector
modes.description: The cannon emits a burst of positive energy that grants itself and each creature of your choice within 10ft of it temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

note: For Jaygar specifically, his custom alchemical heavy crossbow serves as his Eldritch Cannon in Force Ballista mode. The crossbow is the cannon.

name: Arcane Firearm
description: You know how to turn a wand, staff, or rod into an arcane firearm, a conduit for your destructive spells. When you finish a long rest, you can use woodcarver's tools to carve special sigils into a wand, staff, or rod and thereby turn it into your arcane firearm. The sigils disappear from the object if you later carve them on a different item. The sigils otherwise last indefinitely. You can use your arcane firearm as a spellcasting focus for your artificer spells. When you cast an artificer spell through the firearm, roll a d8 and you gain a bonus to one of the spell's damage rolls equal to the number rolled.
note: For Jaygar specifically, his custom alchemical heavy crossbow is his arcane firearm. Homebrew extension of the feature from wand/staff/rod to crossbow to fit his established character concept.

name: Arbalist Bonus Spells
source: Renamed from Artillerist Bonus Spells (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — content unchanged, only the name updated to match this subclass.
description: You always have certain spells prepared once you reach a certain level in this class, as shown below. These spells count as artificer spells for you, but they don't count against the number of artificer spells you prepare. 3rd level: Shield, Thunderwave. 5th level: Scorching Ray, Shatter. 9th level: Fireball, Wind Wall. 13th level: Ice Storm, Wall of Fire. 17th level: Cone of Cold, Wall of Force.

name: Calculating Arbalister
source: Homebrew — Infused Arbalist (built on Tasha's Cauldron of Everything's Artillerist framework, heavily modified). No direct RAW equivalent; loosely modeled on Battle Smith's real Battle Ready (Intelligence for attack/damage rolls with a magic weapon), scoped to a single bonded weapon.
description: You form a permanent bond with a single ranged weapon. While wielding your bonded weapon, you use your Intelligence modifier in place of Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls. This applies at all times, whether or not Infuse Weapon is currently active on it.
note: For Jaygar specifically, his bonded weapon is his custom alchemical heavy crossbow.

name: Infuse Weapon
source: Homebrew — Infused Arbalist. Replaces Artillerist's Eldritch Cannon (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything): the bonded weapon itself carries the magic instead of a separately summoned object.
uses_note: One free (re)binding per long rest. If your bonded weapon is destroyed and you want it back before your next long rest, rebinding costs your action and a spell slot instead.
description: Use your action to infuse your bonded weapon. While infused, it gains a pool of shots (6 at 3rd level, 9 at 9th, 12 at 15th — refills on a long rest), split evenly among fire, acid, and thunder damage. Making a shot is a ranged spell attack using your spell attack modifier, range 120ft, dealing 2d8 damage of the chosen type on a hit (3d8 at 9th level — see Unstable Rounds). Your action can be spent to fire a shot instead of a normal weapon attack, and your bonus action can also fire a shot — up to 2 shots per turn, each consuming one from the pool. You can always make an ordinary weapon attack with the bonded weapon instead (using Calculating Arbalister's Intelligence bonus, normal weapon damage, no elemental type) without spending a shot. While infused, the weapon has hit points equal to 5 times your artificer level, tracking cumulative damage you personally take while it remains bound — healing you receive doesn't reduce this total, and Mending can physically repair the weapon but can't restore what it's lost magically (per Mending's own rules). If these hit points reach 0, the infusion ends immediately and the weapon detonates: the attack that reduced it to 0 and the explosion resolve as a single combined event. Each creature within 10ft makes a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking damage equal to the weapon's explosion dice (2d8 at 3rd level, 3d8 at 9th, 4d8 at 15th — doubled at 15th via Twin Barrels) on a failure, half as much on a success.
note: For Jaygar specifically, this replaces Eldritch Cannon — his custom alchemical heavy crossbow is both the infused weapon and, from 15th level (Twin Barrels), effectively two cannons in one.

name: Arcane Payload
source: Homebrew — Infused Arbalist. Renamed/reflavored from Artillerist's real Arcane Firearm (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — mechanically identical, reflavored from a wand/staff/rod focus to the bonded weapon.
description: Your bonded weapon can serve as your spellcasting focus for your artificer spells. When you cast an artificer spell through it, roll a d8 and gain a bonus to one of the spell's damage rolls equal to the number rolled.

name: Unstable Rounds
source: Homebrew — Infused Arbalist. Renamed/reflavored from Artillerist's real Explosive Cannon (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything), 9th level — keeps the damage-die increase, drops the voluntary self-detonate (doesn't fit a weapon that's meant to stay intact).
description: Your Infuse Weapon shots become more dangerous: their damage die increases from 2d8 to 3d8.

name: Twin Barrels
source: Homebrew — Infused Arbalist. Renamed/reflavored from Artillerist's real Fortified Position (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything), 15th level — keeps both real clauses (bigger destruction-explosion, half cover), reflavored to fit a personal weapon instead of a standalone emplacement.
description: Your bonded weapon's second barrel awakens. Its destruction-explosion (see Infuse Weapon) doubles, from 4d8 to 8d8. Additionally, while your weapon is infused, you and any creatures of your choice within 10ft of you gain half cover, shielded by the magical barrier the weapon projects.

name: Fortified Position
description: You're a master at forming well-defended emplacements using Eldritch Cannon. You and your allies have half cover while within 10ft of a cannon you create with Eldritch Cannon, taking into account only a cannon that you can see. Additionally, you can now have two cannons out at the same time — you can create a second cannon without first destroying the one you already have.

name: Infusion: Repeating Shot
item_requirement: A simple or martial weapon with the ammunition property
description: This magic weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it when it's used to make a ranged attack, and it ignores the loading property if it has it. If the weapon lacks ammunition, it produces its own, automatically creating one piece of magic ammunition when the wielder makes a ranged attack with it. The ammunition produced by the weapon vanishes the instant after it hits or misses a target.

name: Infusion: Enhanced Arcane Focus
description: While holding this item, a creature gains a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. At artificer level 10 this increases to +2. The holder also ignores half cover when making spell attacks.
note: For Jaygar applied to his crossbow as arcane firearm — bonus increases to +2 at level 10.

name: Infusion: Armor of Magical Strength
description: This armor has 6 charges. The wearer can use the armor's charges in the following ways: when the wearer makes a Strength check or a Strength saving throw, it can expend 1 charge to add a bonus to the roll equal to its Intelligence modifier (this is not a reaction — the bonus is added when the roll is made, before the outcome is known). If the wearer would be knocked prone, it can use its reaction to expend 1 charge to avoid being knocked prone. The armor regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Infusion: Lantern of Revealing
description: While lit this lantern sheds bright light in a 30ft radius and dim light for an additional 30ft. Invisible creatures and objects within the bright light area are revealed — they are visible and can be seen clearly for the duration the lantern remains lit. The lantern burns for 6 hours on a flask of oil.

name: Artillerist Bonus Spells
description: You always have the following spells prepared. They do not count against the number of artificer spells you can prepare. If you gain an artillerist spell that does not appear on the artificer spell list, the spell is nonetheless an artificer spell for you.

name: Bladesong
description: You invoke an ancient elven magic as a bonus action. While active (up to 1 minute), you gain a bonus to AC equal to your INT modifier, your walking speed increases by 10 ft, you have advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and you gain a bonus to Constitution saves to maintain concentration equal to your INT modifier. Ends early if you are incapacitated, don medium or heavy armor or a shield, or use two hands to make an attack. Usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, all regained on a long rest (the older SCAG version was a flat 2 uses per short/long rest — Tasha's Cauldron of Everything's current version, cited below, replaced that with this formula).
source: Tasha's Cauldron of Everything (current version — supersedes the original Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide printing)

name: Totemic Assault
description: When hitting with a weapon or cantrip, channel spirit energy for 1d8 lightning or cold damage.

name: Life Bearer
description: When casting a healing spell, add WIS modifier to the healing done.

name: Totemic Blessing
description: Bind any totem and use its effect as a bonus action when healing an ally.

name: Spirit Communion
description: Once per long rest, speak directly with any spirit within one mile, asking three questions.

name: Sacred Focus: Mind
description: Add WIS modifier to Intelligence and Charisma checks and saving throws.

name: Dagger of Swift Strike
description: Once per turn on a hit with this dagger, immediately make a second strike with it as part of the same attack. No bonus action required.
note: Item feature, not a class feature — stored here because it has a rules definition that needs to be referenced.

name: Tactical Foresight
description: When using the Help action, target two allies instead of one. Each gains a bonus to their next saving throw equal to the user's INT modifier.
source: Homebrew, granted by The Weaver's Master-Awl — flavor-inspired by Master of Tactics (Mastermind, Xanathar's Guide to Everything), but grants its own enhanced Help action to whoever wields the awl, regardless of class or subclass (confirmed: Torrin himself is Soulknife, not Mastermind, and this already works for him).

name: Commander's Presence
description: Passive aura, 30ft radius. Allies within range gain +1 to AC and +1 to all saving throws from the user's constant tactical direction, threat assessment, and battlefield positioning advice. Does not require an action or concentration.
source: Homebrew legendary trait, first granted to Torrin — no class dependency, reusable for other characters.

name: The Retired Special
description: Once per day, reaction when an ally is hit: toss a psychic thread and pull the ally up to 15ft to an unoccupied space, potentially causing the attack to miss.
source: Homebrew, granted by The Weaver's Master-Awl to whoever wields it — no class dependency.

name: Grandmaster's Stitch
description: During a long rest, touch a leather armor or leather item. That item becomes infused for 24 hours — wearer gains resistance to Psychic damage and advantage on saving throws against Charmed and Frightened.
source: Homebrew, granted by The Weaver's Master-Awl to whoever wields it — no class dependency.

name: Sentinel
description: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, its speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn. Creatures provoke opportunity attacks even if they took the Disengage action. When a creature within 5ft attacks a target other than you, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.

name: Dual Wielder
description: +1 AC while wielding a melee weapon in each hand. Can use two-weapon fighting with non-light weapons. Can draw or stow two weapons at once.

name: Great Weapon Master
description: On a critical hit or killing blow with a heavy melee weapon: make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action. Before making a melee attack with a heavy weapon: take -5 to hit for +10 damage.
note: Decide before the roll whether to use the -5/+10 option.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage. Ranged attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover. Before making a ranged attack: take -5 to hit for +10 damage.
note: Decide before the roll whether to use the -5/+10 option.

name: War Caster
description: Advantage on CON saving throws to maintain concentration. Can perform somatic components with hands full. Can cast a spell as an opportunity attack — must target only the provoking creature, casting time must be 1 action.

name: Mobile
description: +10ft movement speed. Difficult terrain doesn't cost extra movement when you Dash. When you make a melee attack against a creature, you don't provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn regardless of hit or miss.

name: Observant
description: +5 passive Perception. +5 passive Investigation. Can read lips if you can see the creature's mouth and it is speaking a language you know. +1 INT or WIS.

name: Inspiring Leader
description: Spend 10 minutes speaking to up to 6 friendly creatures who can hear and understand you. Each gains temporary HP equal to your level + CHA modifier. Creatures cannot benefit again until they finish a short or long rest.
note: Must spend 10 minutes — plan before combat, not during.

name: Slasher
description: +1 STR or DEX. On a hit with a slashing weapon: target's speed reduced by 10ft until start of your next turn. On a critical hit with a slashing weapon: target has disadvantage on attack rolls until start of your next turn.

name: Fey Touched
description: +1 INT, WIS, or CHA. Learn Misty Step and one 1st level divination or enchantment spell. Cast each once per long rest without a spell slot. Can also cast using spell slots.
note: Specify which 1st level spell each character chose.

name: Fade Away
description: Prerequisite: Gnome. +1 DEX or INT (max 20). Immediately after taking damage, use your reaction to turn invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or force a saving throw. Once per short or long rest.

name: Shadow Touched
description: +1 INT, WIS, or CHA. Learn Invisibility and one 1st level illusion or necromancy spell. Cast each once per long rest without a spell slot. Can also cast using spell slots.
note: Specify which 1st level spell each character chose.

name: Disarming Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. On a hit: add Superiority Die to damage. Target makes STR or DEX save (DC = 8 + proficiency + STR or DEX mod) or drops one held item of your choice.

name: Precision Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die before the attack roll. Add the die to the attack roll. Can use after seeing the roll but before knowing if it hits.
note: Use this to turn near-misses into hits.

name: Riposte
description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack: expend one Superiority Die as a reaction to make one melee weapon attack against that creature. On a hit: add Superiority Die to damage.

name: Menacing Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. On a hit: add Superiority Die to damage. Target makes WIS save (DC = 8 + proficiency + STR or DEX mod) or is frightened of you until end of your next turn.

name: Superiority Dice
description: Pool of d10s used to fuel Battle Master maneuvers. At level 7: 4 dice. Recharge on short or long rest.
note: Track current dice separately in active_effects or character sheet.

name: Agonizing Blast
description: Add CHA modifier to Eldritch Blast damage rolls. Applies to each beam separately.

name: Devil's Sight
description: See normally in darkness — both magical and nonmagical — to 120ft.
note: Pairs exceptionally well with Hunger of Hadar.

name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
description: Read all writing. Any language, any script, any surface. No action required.
note: Kerra has been using this quietly for years without mentioning it.

name: Armor of Shadows
description: You can cast mage armor on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

name: Beast Speech
description: You can cast speak with animals at will, without expending a spell slot.

name: Beguiling Influence
description: You gain proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills.

name: Book of Ancient Secrets
description: You can now inscribe magical rituals in your Book of Shadows. Choose two 1st-level spells that have the ritual tag from any class's spell list (the two needn't be from the same list). The spells appear in the book and don't count against the number of spells you know. With your Book of Shadows in hand, you can cast the chosen spells as rituals. You can't cast the spells except as rituals, unless you've learned them by some other means. You can also cast a warlock spell you know as a ritual if it has the ritual tag. On your adventures, you can add other ritual spells to your Book of Shadows. When you find such a spell, you can add it to the book if the spell's level is equal to or less than half your warlock level (rounded up) and if you can spare the time to transcribe the spell. For each level of the spell, the transcription process takes 2 hours and costs 50 gp for the rare inks needed to inscribe it.

name: Eldritch Sight
description: You can cast detect magic at will, without expending a spell slot.

name: Eldritch Spear
description: When you cast eldritch blast, its range is 300 feet.

name: Fiendish Vigor
description: You can cast false life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without expending a spell slot or material components.

name: Gaze of Two Minds
description: You can use your action to touch a willing humanoid and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn. As long as the creature is on the same plane of existence as you, you can use your action on subsequent turns to maintain this connection, extending the duration until the end of your next turn. While perceiving through the other creature's senses, you benefit from any special senses possessed by that creature, and you are blinded and deafened to your own surroundings.

name: Mask of Many Faces
description: You can cast disguise self at will, without expending a spell slot.

name: Misty Visions
description: You can cast silent image at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

name: Repelling Blast
description: When you hit a creature with eldritch blast, you can push the creature up to 10 feet away from you in a straight line.

name: Thief of Five Fates
description: You can cast bane once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Voice of the Chain Master
description: You can communicate telepathically with your familiar and perceive through your familiar's senses as long as you are on the same plane of existence. Additionally, while perceiving through your familiar's senses, you can also speak through your familiar in your own voice, even if your familiar is normally incapable of speech.

name: Mire the Mind
description: You can cast slow once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: One with Shadows
description: When you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use your action to become invisible until you move or take an action or a reaction.

name: Sign of Ill Omen
description: You can cast bestow curse once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Bewitching Whispers
description: You can cast compulsion once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Dreadful Word
description: You can cast confusion once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Sculptor of Flesh
description: You can cast polymorph once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Ascendant Step
description: You can cast levitate on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

name: Minions of Chaos
description: You can cast conjure elemental once using a warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

name: Otherworldly Leap
description: You can cast jump on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot or material components.

name: Whispers of the Grave
description: You can cast speak with dead at will, without expending a spell slot.

name: Lifedrinker
description: When you hit a creature with your pact weapon, the creature takes extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

name: Chains of Carceri
description: You can cast hold monster at will—targeting a celestial, fiend, or elemental—without expending a spell slot or material components. You must finish a long rest before you can use this invocation on the same creature again.

name: Master of Myriad Forms
description: You can cast alter self at will, without expending a spell slot.

name: Visions of Distant Realms
description: You can cast arcane eye at will, without expending a spell slot.

name: Witch Sight
description: You can see the true form of any shapechanger or creature concealed by illusion or transmutation magic while the creature is within 30 feet of you and within line of sight.

name: Alchemical Savant
description: You've developed a masterful command of magical chemicals. Whenever you cast a spell using your alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus, you gain a bonus to one roll of the spell equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1). If the spell deals fire, acid, necrotic, or poison damage, the bonus applies to one of its damage rolls; if the spell restores hit points, the bonus applies to the amount restored.

name: Experimental Elixir
description: Whenever you finish a long rest, you magically produce an experimental elixir in an empty flask you touch (thieves' tools or alchemist's supplies in hand). A creature can drink the elixir as an action; roll a d6 (or choose) to determine its effect. Any elixir you don't use lasts until the end of your next long rest, then becomes inert.

elixirs.name: Healing
elixirs.description: The drinker regains 2d4 + your Intelligence modifier hit points.

elixirs.name: Swiftness
elixirs.description: The drinker's walking speed increases by 10 feet for 1 hour.

elixirs.name: Resilience
elixirs.description: The drinker gains a +1 bonus to AC for 10 minutes.

elixirs.name: Boldness
elixirs.description: The drinker can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to every attack roll and saving throw they make for 1 minute.

elixirs.name: Flight
elixirs.description: The drinker gains a flying speed of 10 feet for 10 minutes.

elixirs.name: Transformation
elixirs.description: The drinker's body is transformed as though by the alter self spell (choose the option when the elixir is made). The drinker can end this effect on themself as an action; otherwise it lasts 10 minutes.

name: Restorative Reagents
description: Whenever a creature drinks an experimental elixir you created, the creature gains temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). Additionally, you can cast Lesser Restoration without expending a spell slot and without preparing it, provided you use your alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus — a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), regaining all expended uses on a long rest.

name: Chemical Mastery
description: You gain resistance to acid and poison damage, and you are immune to the poisoned condition. You can also cast Greater Restoration and Heal without expending a spell slot, without preparing them, and without material components, provided you use your alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus. You can cast each of these spells this way once, regaining the ability to do so on a long rest.

name: Tools of the Trade
description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor and with smith's tools. If you already have proficiency with smith's tools, you instead gain proficiency with one other type of artisan's tools of your choice.

name: Arcane Armor
description: Using smith's tools, you can turn a suit of armor you're wearing into a magical arcane armor. Whenever you don this armor, it magically attaches to you and can't be removed against your will; doffing it also requires an action. While wearing it: it counts as heavy armor that doesn't require Strength to wear, it can serve as your spellcasting focus for artificer spells, and if you have no hands or feet, it fills in a set (with a retractable helmet as a bonus action). You choose an armor model — Guardian or Infiltrator — the first time you create arcane armor; you can change your model whenever you finish a long rest with smith's tools in hand.

name: Armor Model
description: Your arcane armor comes with a built-in weapon and a special defensive benefit, determined by the model you choose. You use your Intelligence modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for attack and damage rolls with the armor's special weapon.

models.name: Guardian
models.description: Thunder Gauntlets (melee weapon built into the armor, otherwise resembles unarmed strikes): 1d8 thunder damage on a hit, and the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone other than you until the start of your next turn. Defensive Field: as a bonus action, gain temporary hit points equal to your artificer level (usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest, or by expending a spell slot).

models.name: Infiltrator
models.description: Lightning Launcher (ranged weapon built into the armor, range 90/300 ft): 1d6 lightning damage on a hit, plus an extra 1d6 lightning damage once per turn if you've hit with it already this turn. Powered Steps: your walking speed increases by 5 feet. Dampening Field: you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

name: Armor Modifications
description: You've learned how to permanently mount magic items onto your arcane armor. The armor now counts as four separate magic items for the purpose of your Infuse Item and other magic item limits: one item for the armor itself, one for its boots, one for its helmet, and one for its special weapon — infusions or other magic bonuses applied to it apply only while it's part of the armor. Additionally, the maximum number of items you can infuse increases by 2.

name: Perfected Armor
description: Your armor model improves further, depending on which model you've chosen.

models.name: Guardian
models.description: As a reaction when a Huge or smaller creature within 30 feet moves away from you or hits you, you can force it to make a Strength saving throw; on a failure it's pulled up to 25 feet toward you, and if this brings it within 5 feet of you, you can make one melee weapon attack against it as part of the reaction. Usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining expended uses on a long rest.

models.name: Infiltrator
models.description: A creature damaged by your Lightning Launcher this turn sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn; the first creature to hit it with an attack during that window has advantage on the attack roll, and if the attack hits, the target takes an extra 1d6 lightning damage.

name: Battle Ready
description: You gain proficiency with martial weapons. Additionally, when you attack with a magic weapon, you can use your Intelligence modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the attack and damage rolls.

name: Steel Defender
description: Using smith's tools over the course of 1 hour, you can build a Steel Defender — a Medium construct that follows your verbal commands and shares your initiative. It has AC 15, HP equal to 2 + your Intelligence modifier + five times your artificer level (regaining all HP on your long rest), and a 40-foot speed. As a bonus action you can command it to take the Attack (one Force-Empowered Rend, 1d8 + your proficiency bonus force damage), Dash, Disengage, Help, or Repair action; without a command it takes the Dodge action. Repair (3/Day) restores 2d8 + your proficiency bonus HP, as an action, to itself or to one construct or object within 5 feet of it — regaining all expended uses on a long rest. As a reaction when a creature the defender can see hits a target other than the defender within 5 feet of it, the defender can impose disadvantage on that attack roll (Deflect Attack). If it dies, you can spend 1 hour and materials worth 200gp to build a new one.

name: Extra Attack
description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

name: Arcane Jolt
description: Immediately after you hit a target with an attack using a magic weapon or your Steel Defender hits a target with an attack, you can channel magical energy through the strike to create one of the following effects: deal an extra 2d6 force damage to the target, or restore 2d6 hit points to a different creature you can see within 30 feet of the target. You can do this a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), regaining all expended uses on a long rest, and no more than once per turn.

name: Improved Defender
description: Your Arcane Jolt damage and healing both increase from 2d6 to 4d6. Your Steel Defender also gains a +2 bonus to AC, and when it uses its Deflect Attack reaction and the attack still hits, the attacker takes force damage equal to 1d4 + your Intelligence modifier.

name: Flash of Genius
description: When you or a creature within 30ft makes an ability check or saving throw: add INT modifier to the roll. Can use a number of times equal to INT modifier per long rest.

name: Tool Expertise
description: Proficiency bonus doubled for any ability check using a tool you are proficient with.

name: Insightful Fighting (Revised)
description: As a bonus action, make an Insight check contested by a target's Charisma/Deception check. On a success, you identify and vocally expose a weakness in the target's defense. While this effect is active: Sneak Attack applies to attacks against this target without requiring advantage or an adjacent ally. Any attack roll against this target, by anyone, whose d20 result equals the unmodified Insight die roll (or standard natural 20) is treated as a critical hit. If the Insight die result was a natural 20, critical hits against this target deal triple damage. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until successfully used against a different target.
source: Homebrew — a modified version of Inquisitive's real Insightful Fighting (Xanathar's Guide to Everything). Check character notes for exactly what changed from RAW.

name: Inquisitive — Steady Eye
description: Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks if you don't move more than half your speed on the same turn.

name: Inquisitive — Unerring Eye
description: Sense magical illusions, shapechanger in disguise, or other magical deception within 30ft. Not exact — you sense something is off, not necessarily what.

name: Scout — Skirmisher
description: When an enemy ends its turn within 5ft of you: move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Scout — Survivalist
description: Gain proficiency in Nature and Survival. Proficiency bonus doubled for these skills.

name: Scout — Superior Mobility
description: +10ft movement speed. If no armor worn, +10ft additionally.

name: Soulknife — Psychic Blades
description: Manifest a psychic blade as part of an attack. 1d6 + your ability modifier (the same one used for the attack) psychic damage, finesse, thrown (60ft). If your other hand is free, you can manifest a second blade as a bonus action on the same turn, dealing 1d4 + the same modifier psychic damage. No material component, appear and vanish instantly.

name: Soulknife — Psionic Energy
description: A pool of Psionic Energy dice, all the same size (d6 at 3rd level, d8 at 5th, d10 at 11th, d12 at 17th — see psionic_energy_die_by_level). You have a number of these dice equal to twice your proficiency bonus. They fuel Psi-Bolstered Knack, Psychic Whispers, Soul Blades, Psychic Veil, and (at higher cost) Rend Mind. Regain all expended dice on a long rest; as a bonus action, regain one expended die, but not again until your next short or long rest.
note: Track current dice in active_effects.

name: Soulknife — Psi-Bolstered Knack
description: If you fail an ability check using a skill or tool proficiency, you can roll a Psionic Energy die and add it to the check, potentially turning the failure into a success. You expend the die only if doing so turns the failure into a success.
note: Die is only spent if it turns the check into a success.

name: Soulknife — Psychic Whispers
description: As an action, expend one Psionic Energy die and choose a number of creatures you can see, up to your proficiency bonus. For a number of hours equal to the number rolled, those creatures can communicate telepathically with you and each other while all within 1 mile of one another.

name: Stars Druid — Starry Form
description: As a bonus action, expend a use of Wild Shape to take on a starry form (instead of a beast shape) for 10 minutes, retaining your own statistics. Choose one constellation: Archer — as the activating bonus action and again as a bonus action on later turns, make a ranged spell attack (a luminous arrow) against one creature within 60ft, dealing 1d8 + Wisdom modifier radiant damage on a hit; Chalice — whenever you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores hit points, you or another creature within 30ft can regain 1d8 + Wisdom modifier extra hit points; Dragon — when you make an Intelligence or Wisdom check, or a Constitution save to maintain concentration, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower as a 10 (this doesn't guarantee success against a high DC, just improves a low roll).
verification: CORRECTED 2026-09-10 — all three constellations had real mechanical errors: Archer is its own independent ranged spell attack (activation + every subsequent turn's bonus action), not "bonus damage added to your spells"; Chalice specifically requires casting a spell using a SPELL SLOT, and lets you choose to heal an ally within 30ft instead of always healing yourself; Dragon applies to Intelligence/Wisdom checks too, not just concentration saves, and "treat as a 10" is not the same as "automatically succeeds" (a high enough DC can still fail it). Also removed a fabricated "recharge: short_rest" — this feature has no independent charge pool at all; it spends a use of Wild Shape itself, whatever that druid's own Wild Shape recharge/uses currently are. All three confirmed via two independent direct-quote fetches. Tackett (Halfling Druid 9, Circle of Stars) is the only roster user — his own sheet's `modes` text repeats the same three errors, and his sheet also tracks Starry Form as its own separate 1-use pool rather than drawing from his actual Wild Shape uses; flagged for the project owner rather than silently restructured, since merging the pools is a real design choice, not just a text fix. His homebrew 4th "Unbroken (Legendary)" mode is a deliberate campaign addition, not RAW, and is unaffected by this correction.

name: Stars Druid — Cosmic Omen
description: After a long rest roll a d6. Even: Weal — use your reaction to roll a d6 and add it to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw a creature within 30ft is about to make. Odd: Woe — same, but subtract the d6 instead. Usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses when you finish a long rest.
note: Roll at start of each long rest to determine Weal or Woe.
verification: CORRECTED 2026-09-10: Weal/Woe were backwards (even is Weal/bonus, odd is Woe/penalty — local data had this flipped), and the proficiency-bonus-per-long-rest use cap was missing entirely (local implied unlimited reaction use). Confirmed via two independent sources. Tackett (Halfling Druid 9, Circle of Stars) is the only roster user — his own sheet caps this at a flat 1 use, when his real cap at level 9 (proficiency bonus +4) should be 4; flagged for a follow-up sheet fix since it's a clear, unambiguous numeric correction.

name: Stars Druid — Full of Stars
description: While in Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal, giving you resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage — unqualified, not just from nonmagical sources.
verification: CORRECTED 2026-09-10: removed a fabricated "from nonmagical attacks" restriction — the real feature's resistance is unqualified (a real, meaningful power difference), confirmed via a direct-quote fetch. No roster character has reached 14th level in this subclass, so no character-sheet impact.

name: Stars Druid — Unbroken (Legendary)
description: Legendary fourth constellation. While active: can maintain concentration on two spells simultaneously, advantage on all concentration saving throws. Duration 10 minutes. Once per long rest.
note: Cannot stack with other Starry Form constellations — this replaces them for the duration.
source: Homebrew — a 4th Starry Form constellation beyond the real 3 (Archer/Chalice/Dragon, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything).

name: Tempest Cleric — Wrath of the Storm
description: When a creature within 5ft hits you: use reaction to deal 2d8 lightning or thunder damage. Target makes DEX save (spell save DC) for half.

name: Tempest Cleric — Destructive Wrath
description: When rolling lightning or thunder damage: replace any roll with maximum damage instead of rolling.
note: Uses Channel Divinity.

name: Tempest Cleric — Thunderbolt Strike
description: When dealing lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature: push it up to 10ft away.

name: Stone's Endurance
description: When you take damage: use reaction to reduce damage by 1d12 + CON modifier.
note: Goliath racial feature.
source: Volo's Guide to Monsters / Player's Handbook (Goliath)

name: Bountiful Luck
description: When an ally within 30ft rolls a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw: use reaction to let them reroll. They must use the new roll.
note: Halfling racial feat. Does not cost Tackett's Lucky feature.

name: Vow of the Open Road
description: As an action, expend one use of Channel Divinity to force a creature within 30 feet that you can see to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature is compelled to move in an unexpected direction (DM's choice, in the spirit of Carix's unpredictable influence) on its next turn.
source: Homebrew — Ferghus's own Oath of the Open Road (not official WotC content, and not the same as the third-party 'Oath of the Open Road' by The Griffon's Saddlebag).

name: Inquisitive — Ear for Deceit
description: Gain proficiency in Insight. Whenever you make a Wisdom (Insight) check, you can treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.

name: Inquisitive — Eye for Detail
description: Use a bonus action to take the Search action, or to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden creature or object, or an Intelligence (Investigation) check to uncover or decipher clues.

name: Scout — Ambush Master
description: Advantage on initiative rolls. Creatures you hit during the first round of combat become easier targets — each ally has advantage on attack rolls against them until the start of your next turn.

name: Master of Tactics
description: Use the Help action as a bonus action. When you use Help to aid an ally attacking a creature, the target can be within 30ft rather than 5ft, provided the target can see or hear you.

name: Old Scores
description: Once per session, Torrin knows someone wherever the party currently is — that person owes him a favor. Purely narrative: opens doors, creates opportunities, no mechanical bonus. 156 years of living leaves marks everywhere.
source: Homebrew, unique to Torrin. Purely narrative, no mechanical effect.

name: Primal Companion
description: Grants a beast companion that fights alongside you, sharing your initiative and following your commands. At this table, the companion's exact combat mechanics live on its own character-like sheet (see the Independent feature and the companion's own stat block) rather than being fully reproduced here — this entry is the marker that the character has the feature at all.
source: Ranger (Beast Master), Tasha's Cauldron of Everything — the base companion mechanics themselves (shares your initiative, takes the Dodge action on your turn unless you spend a bonus action to command it otherwise) are real RAW, unmodified. The house-rule upgrade to a fully independent turn is homebrew and lives on the separate 'Independent' feature, not here.

name: Master of Intrigue
description: You gain proficiency with the disguise kit, the forgery kit, and one gaming set of your choice. You also learn two languages of your choice. Additionally, you can unerringly mimic the speech patterns and accent of a creature that you hear speak for at least 1 minute, though you must know the language to pass yourself off as a speaker of it.
source: Mastermind (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 3rd level.

name: Soulknife — Soul Blades
description: Two benefits: Homing Strikes — when you miss with a psychic blade attack, you can expend one Psionic Energy die, rolling it and adding the result to the attack roll, possibly turning the miss into a hit. Psychic Teleportation — as a bonus action, expend one Psionic Energy die, roll it, and teleport up to 10 feet times the number rolled to an unoccupied space you can see, then make one psychic blade attack against a creature within 5 feet of your destination.
source: Soulknife (Rogue subclass, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — 9th level.

name: Soulknife — Psychic Veil
description: As an action, you can magically become invisible, along with anything you are wearing or carrying, for up to 1 hour. This invisibility ends early if you make an attack, cast a spell, or force a creature to make a saving throw. Once used, you can't use this again until you finish a short or long rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy die to use it again.
source: Soulknife (Rogue subclass, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — 13th level.

name: Soulknife — Rend Mind
description: When you hit a creature with a Sneak Attack using your Psychic Blades, you can force that target to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it's stunned for 1 minute — it can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once used, you can't use this again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend 3 Psionic Energy dice to use it again.
source: Soulknife (Rogue subclass, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — 17th level.

name: Insightful Manipulator
description: If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own — whether it's your equal, superior, or inferior in two of the following characteristics of your choice: Intelligence score, Wisdom score, Charisma score, class levels (if any).
source: Mastermind (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 9th level.

name: Misdirection
description: If a creature you can see targets you with an attack, you can use your reaction to designate another creature within 5 feet of you as the recipient of that attack instead, provided that other creature is granting you cover from the attack.
source: Mastermind (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 13th level.

name: Soul of Deceit
description: Your thoughts can't be read by telepathy or other means unless you allow it, and you can present false thoughts to a creature attempting to read them by succeeding on a Charisma (Deception) check against the creature's Wisdom (Insight) check. You can also fool magic that would determine whether you're telling the truth and can't be compelled to tell the truth by magic.
source: Mastermind (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 17th level.

name: Blessed Strikes
description: When your weapon attack or cantrip damages a creature, you can expend a use of Divine Strike or Potent Spellcasting (whichever you have) to deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage to the target. You can use this benefit only once per turn.
note: Optional class feature from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything, replaces Divine Strike.

name: Sacred Weapon
description: As an action, expend one use of Channel Divinity to imbue one weapon you are holding with positive energy. For 1 minute: add CHA modifier to attack rolls (minimum +1), weapon counts as magical, emits bright light in 20ft radius and dim light 20ft beyond. You can end the effect early as part of any other action; it also ends immediately if you're no longer holding or carrying the weapon, or if you fall unconscious.
verification: CORRECTED 2026-09-10: added two missing early-termination conditions (voluntary end as part of another action; automatic end on dropping the weapon or falling unconscious), confirmed via a direct-quote fetch. This is real PHB content reused by Ferghus's homebrew Oath of the Open Road (paladin-oath-of-the-open-road.json) as well as Oath of Devotion — Ferghus (Paladin 9) has this feature, no local override, so this fix applies to him too.

name: Assassinate
description: Starting at 3rd level, you are at your deadliest when you get the drop on your enemies. You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in the combat yet. In addition, any hit you score against a creature that is surprised is a critical hit.

name: Dread Ambusher
description:
At 3rd level, you master the art of the ambush. You can give yourself a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Wisdom modifier.

At the start of your first turn of each combat, your walking speed increases by 10 feet, which lasts until the end of that turn. If you take the Attack action on that turn, you can make one additional weapon attack as part of that action. If that attack hits, the target takes an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's damage type.

name: Umbral Sight
description:
At 3rd level, you gain darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision from your race, its range increases by 30 feet.

You are also adept at evading creatures that rely on darkvision. While in darkness, you are invisible to any creature that relies on darkvision to see you in that darkness.

name: Tattoo of Warding
description: Once per long rest, as a reaction, you may completely block one incoming ranged attack — negating all damage and effects from that attack. The tattoo is inscribed on the sword arm and activates instinctively.

name: Divine Magic
description: Divine Soul Sorcerer feature. You have access to the full Cleric spell list in addition to the Sorcerer spell list — when your Spellcasting feature lets you learn a cantrip or a spell of 1st level or higher, you may choose it from either list. You also gain one bonus spell for free based on your chosen affinity, always prepared and not counting against your spells known: Good grants Cure Wounds, Evil grants Inflict Wounds, Law grants Bless, Chaos grants Bane, and Neutrality grants Protection from Evil and Good.
verification: CORRECTED 2026-09-10: the affinity-based free bonus spell (Good/Evil/Law/Chaos/Neutrality) was entirely missing from this catalog entry — confirmed via a direct-quote fetch. Rith (Sorcerer 9, Divine Soul) already has this correctly applied on his own character sheet (Bless, tagged as his Law-affinity Divine Magic bonus spell, per an earlier session's character-specific fix) — this fix brings the shared catalog text in line with what his sheet already modeled correctly, rather than the other way around.

name: Favored by the Gods
description: Divine Soul Sorcerer feature. When you fail a saving throw or miss with an attack roll, you can roll 2d4 and add it to the total, possibly changing the outcome. Once used, cannot be used again until you finish a short or long rest.

name: Empowered Healing
description: Divine Soul Sorcerer feature. When you or an ally within 5 feet of you rolls dice to determine hit points restored by a spell, you may spend 1 sorcery point (provided you aren't incapacitated) to reroll any number of those dice once, taking the new result. Usable only once per turn.
verification: CORRECTED 2026-09-10: added two missing real limiters — you must not be incapacitated to use it, and it's capped at once per turn (local text previously implied unlimited use). Confirmed via a direct-quote fetch. Rith (Sorcerer 9, Divine Soul) has this feature; no numeric tracking exists on his sheet for it (correctly left as a live judgment call, same pattern as other once-per-turn resource limits in this app).

name: Weave Embodiment
description: Once per long rest, cast your CURRENT phase's level-1 grid spell without expending a spell slot: Shield (Leno), Silvery Barbs (Twill), Color Spray (Satin). To access another phase's free cast, first switch into it with Mother's Whim (1 SP) — up to 3 free casts per long rest total (one per phase) if you pay to cycle through all three.
source: Homebrew — Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass), a reskin of Lunar Sorcery.

name: Loom Fire
description: You know Sacred Flame (doesn't count against cantrips known). When you cast it, you may target one creature as normal OR target two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other, each making its own DEX save.
source: Homebrew — Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass), a reskin of Lunar Sorcery.

name: Mother's Whim
description: Two separate effects bundled into one feature. (1) Shifting: as a bonus action, spend 1 Sorcery Point to change your active Weave Phase to a different one (Leno/Twill/Satin) — costs 1 SP every time you shift, no cap on the number of shifts beyond available SP. (2) Discount: whenever you apply Metamagic to a spell belonging to your CURRENT phase's school pair, reduce its SP cost by 1 (minimum 0). Usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest, refreshing on a long rest — independent of how many times you've shifted phase.
source: Homebrew — Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass), a reskin of Lunar Sorcery.

name: Leno Phase (Abjuration / Divination)
description: Active phase: 1 SP discount on Metamagic for Abjuration and Divination spells (see Mother's Whim). All five grid spells for this phase are always known and prepared regardless of which phase is currently active — cast any of them normally with a spell slot of the appropriate level, exactly like any other prepared spell. Only the level-1 spell's free (no-slot) cast is phase-gated (see Weave Embodiment). Grid: Shield (1st), Lesser Restoration (2nd), Dispel Magic (3rd), Death Ward (4th), Rary's Telepathic Bond (5th).
source: Homebrew — Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass), a reskin of Lunar Sorcery.

name: Twill Phase (Enchantment / Necromancy)
description: Active phase: 1 SP discount on Metamagic for Enchantment and Necromancy spells (see Mother's Whim). All five grid spells for this phase are always known and prepared regardless of which phase is currently active — cast any of them normally with a spell slot of the appropriate level, exactly like any other prepared spell. Only the level-1 spell's free (no-slot) cast is phase-gated (see Weave Embodiment). Grid: Silvery Barbs (1st), Blindness/Deafness (2nd), Vampiric Touch (3rd), Confusion (4th), Synaptic Static (5th).
source: Homebrew — Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass), a reskin of Lunar Sorcery.

name: Satin Phase (Illusion / Transmutation)
description: Active phase: 1 SP discount on Metamagic for Illusion and Transmutation spells (see Mother's Whim). All five grid spells for this phase are always known and prepared regardless of which phase is currently active — cast any of them normally with a spell slot of the appropriate level, exactly like any other prepared spell. Only the level-1 spell's free (no-slot) cast is phase-gated (see Weave Embodiment). Grid: Color Spray (1st), Alter Self (2nd), Phantom Steed (3rd), Fabricate (4th), Telekinesis (5th).
source: Homebrew — Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass), a reskin of Lunar Sorcery.

name: Weave Empowerment
description: Passive, tied to your currently active phase. Leno: as a bonus action, your markings blaze — shed bright light in a 10ft radius and dim light 10ft beyond; you and creatures of your choice within that light gain advantage on Investigation and Perception checks. Twill: advantage on Stealth checks; while you are entirely in an area of darkness, attack rolls against you have disadvantage. Satin: resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.
source: Homebrew — Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass), a reskin of Lunar Sorcery's Lunar Empowerment.

name: Unraveling
description: Bonus action, usable once per long rest (or spend 5 Sorcery Points to use it again), and can be combined with a Mother's Whim phase shift. Leno: 30ft radius burst of unweaving light — each creature in the area makes a CON save or is blinded until the end of its next turn; choose one creature in range to regain 3d8 hit points. Twill: 30ft radius burst of unraveling shadow-thread — each creature in the area makes a DEX save or takes 3d10 necrotic damage and has its speed reduced to 0; you become invisible until the end of your next turn. Satin: the Weave folds — teleport up to 60ft to an unoccupied space you can see, bringing one willing creature within 5ft of you along; you and that creature gain resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn.
source: Homebrew — Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass), a reskin of Lunar Sorcery's Lunar Phenomenon.

name: Manifest Echo
description: As a bonus action, manifest an echo of yourself — a translucent gray image — in an unoccupied space you can see within 15ft. Echo stats: AC 14 + your proficiency bonus, 1 HP, immune to all conditions, uses your saving throws, same size as you. It lasts until destroyed, until dismissed as a bonus action, until you manifest another echo, until you're incapacitated, or until it ends your turn more than 30ft from you. While it exists you also have access to Echo: Reposition, Echo: Swap Places, Echo: Attack From, and Echo: Opportunity Attack.
source: Echo Knight (Fighter subclass, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — 3rd level. Split into separate entries below so each shows up correctly under the action/bonus action/reaction filter instead of being buried as prose inside one feature.

name: Echo: Reposition
description: No action required — while your echo exists, mentally move it up to 30ft in any direction, any number of times on your turn. It's destroyed if it ends your turn more than 30ft from you.
source: Echo Knight (Fighter subclass, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — part of Manifest Echo, 3rd level.

name: Echo: Swap Places
description: As a bonus action, teleport-swap positions with your echo, regardless of the distance between you. Costs 15ft of your movement for that turn in addition to the bonus action.
source: Echo Knight (Fighter subclass, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — part of Manifest Echo, 3rd level.

name: Echo: Attack From
description: When you take the Attack action, each attack you make as part of it can originate from your own space or your echo's space, chosen individually per attack. No extra action cost — a targeting option within the Attack action itself, distinct from Unleash Incarnation's separate bonus attack.
source: Echo Knight (Fighter subclass, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — part of Manifest Echo, 3rd level.
table_ruling: RAW is genuinely ambiguous about how far 'the attack originates from the echo's space' extends. Locked in as the table ruling: for a standard attack made this way, it only affects range/targeting for that attack — the character's real body stays where it actually is for every other purpose (reach against them, opportunity attacks against them, etc.). Contrast with Unleash Incarnation below, which is ruled differently.

name: Echo: Opportunity Attack
description: When a creature you can see within 5ft of your echo moves at least 5ft away from it, you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack against that creature as if you were standing in the echo's space.
source: Echo Knight (Fighter subclass, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — part of Manifest Echo, 3rd level.

name: Unleash Incarnation
description: Whenever you take the Attack action, you can make one additional melee attack from your echo's position. Usable a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum once), regaining all expended uses on a long rest.
source: Echo Knight (Fighter subclass, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount) — 3rd level.
table_ruling: Ruled differently from Echo: Attack From's standard attacks: this genuinely treats the character as positioned at the echo for that one attack, full stop — not just range/targeting, but for any purpose that specific attack would care about.

name: Fancy Footwork
description: If you make a melee attack against a creature on your turn, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.
source: Swashbuckler (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 3rd level.

name: Rakish Audacity
description: You gain a bonus to your Initiative rolls equal to your Charisma modifier. In addition, you don't need advantage on the attack roll to use Sneak Attack against a creature if you're within 5ft of it, no other creature is within 5ft of you, and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll — this replaces the normal Sneak Attack requirement of advantage or an ally adjacent to the target.
source: Swashbuckler (Rogue subclass, Xanathar's Guide to Everything) — 3rd level.

name: Elven Accuracy
description: Prerequisite: Elf or half-elf. Increase Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1 (max 20). Whenever you have advantage on an attack roll using Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can reroll one of the dice once.

name: Fey Ancestry
description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

name: Darkvision
description: You can see in dim light within 60ft as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray. Range may vary by race — check the character's own darkvision field for their actual range.

name: Sixty Leagues Before Dusk
description: 1 action, touch, up to 4 mounts within 30ft. Devised across centuries spent alone tending ground too vast for any one warden to walk twice. Each target's speed increases by 20 feet for 8 hours.
source: Homebrew — signature feature unique to Therynv'l.

name: Aasimar Transformation
description:
Choose one transformation at activation, lasting 1 minute:

Starry Flight: Spectral wings grant 30ft fly speed; emit dim light in 10ft radius.

Supernova: At the start of each creature's turn within 10ft, they take proficiency bonus radiant damage. You shed bright light 10ft, dim 10ft beyond.

Divine Attractor: Each creature of your choice within 30ft must succeed on a CHA saving throw or be Blinded until the start of their next turn, and take proficiency bonus psychic damage at the start of their turn while Blinded.
source: Homebrew Aasimar variant, combining Radiant Soul/Radiant Consumption/Necrotic Shroud (all real Aasimar 3rd-level features) into one choose-one-at-activation ability.

name: Abjuration Savant
description: The gold and time you must spend to copy an abjuration spell into your spellbook is halved.

name: Assassin — Infiltration Expertise
description: You can unfailingly create false identities for yourself. This process requires 7 days and 25gp, establishing history, profession, and affiliations for the identity, including appropriate documents, letters, and disguise materials. You can't establish an identity that belongs to someone else. If you adopt the new identity as a disguise, other creatures believe you to be that person until given an obvious reason not to.

name: Awakened Mind
description: You can communicate telepathically with any creature you can see within 30ft. You don't need to share a language for the creature to understand you, but it must be able to understand at least one language.

name: Bladesinger — Training in War and Song
description: You gain proficiency with light armor, and proficiency with one type of one-handed melee weapon of your choice. You also gain proficiency in the Performance skill if you don't already have it.
source: Bladesinging (Wizard subclass, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — 2nd level.

name: Brave
description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

name: Celestial Resistance
description: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.
source: Volo's Guide to Monsters / Player's Handbook (Aasimar)

name: Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge
description: As a bonus action, you issue a challenge that compels other creatures to do battle with you. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 30ft of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can't willingly move more than 30ft away from you. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or die, or if the creature ends up more than 30ft away from you.

name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Tide
description: As a bonus action, you can bolster injured creatures with your Channel Divinity. Each creature of your choice that can hear you within 30ft of you regains hit points equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1), provided it has no more than half its hit points remaining.

name: Combat Wild Shape
description: You can use Wild Shape as a bonus action rather than an action. While shaped, you can cast a druid spell with a casting time of 1 action by expending a spell slot, or use a bonus action to expend a spell slot and regain 1d8 hit points per level of the slot expended.

name: Crown — Divine Allegiance
description: When a creature within 5ft of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to magically substitute your own health for that creature's — the creature takes no damage, and you take the damage instead. This damage to you can't be reduced or prevented in any way.

name: Destroy Undead (CR 1)
description: When an undead fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead Channel Divinity, it is instantly destroyed if its challenge rating is at or below the threshold for your cleric level (1/2 at 5th level, 1 at 8th level, 2 at 11th level, 3 at 14th level, 4 at 17th level). The name reflects the current threshold reached.

name: Eldritch Cannon — Explosive Cannon
description: Cannon damage upgraded to 3d8. As an action, if you are within 60ft of the cannon, you can command it to detonate — each creature within 20ft makes a DEX save against your spell save DC or takes 3d8 force damage, half on success. The cannon is destroyed after detonating.
source: Tasha's Cauldron of Everything — Artillerist, 9th level (Explosive Cannon).

name: Elemental Cleaver
description: When you enter your rage, you can infuse one weapon you're holding with acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage. While you wield it during your rage, the weapon's damage type changes to the chosen type, it deals an extra 1d6 damage of that type on a hit, and it gains the thrown property (normal range 20ft, long range 60ft) — if thrown, it reappears in your hand the instant after it hits or misses. The benefits are suppressed while another creature wields it. While raging and holding it, you can use a bonus action to change its damage type.
source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Elven Weapon Training
description: Proficiency with longswords, shortswords, shortbows, and longbows.

name: Empowered Spell
description: Metamagic. When you roll damage for a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one), using the new rolls. Can be used even if another Metamagic option was used on the same spell.

name: Fey Step
description: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30ft to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses on a long rest. At 3rd level, using Fey Step also triggers an additional effect tied to your chosen season (Autumn/Winter/Spring/Summer), each with a different secondary benefit or effect on nearby creatures.
source: Dungeon Master's Guide (Eladrin) / Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes

name: Fleet of Foot
description: Base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

name: Flyby
description: The creature doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of a creature's reach.

name: Giant's Havoc
description: While raging, you become Large (along with anything you're wearing; your equipment doesn't change size), your reach increases by 5ft, and you can add your Rage Damage bonus to damage rolls when you hit with a thrown weapon.
source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Gnome Cunning
description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

name: Guiding Whispers
description: You learn the Guidance cantrip without it counting against the number of Bard cantrips you know, and you can cast it at a range of up to 60ft (rather than the normal touch range).
source: College of Spirits (Bard subclass, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — 3rd level.

name: Healing Touch
description: Touch a creature to restore hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + CHA modifier.
source: Homebrew — Weave Attunement (Sorcerer subclass), a reskin of Lunar Sorcery.

name: Hellish Resistance
description: You have resistance to fire damage.

name: Independent
description: The companion acts on its own initiative, entirely independent of its bonded character — it does not require the character's action or bonus action to act, and does not share the character's turn. Table houserule: this is a stronger version of the published Primal Companion 'Independent' feature (which normally keeps the beast acting only on the ranger's turn); here the companion gets a full, separate turn in the initiative order.
source: Homebrew companion feature (upgraded from Ranger Primal Companion, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — used by Perch.

name: Infernal Legacy
description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast Hellish Rebuke once as a 2nd-level spell, regaining the ability on a long rest. At 5th level, you can cast Darkness once, regaining the ability on a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these.

name: Infusion: Clockwork Amulet
description: Once per dawn, when making an attack roll, forgo rolling and treat the d20 as a 10.
source: Homebrew — custom infusion specific to Jaygar. Infuse Item itself is real Artificer (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything); this specific infusion is not.

name: Infusion: Helm of Comprehending Languages
description: While wearing this helm, the wearer can read any written language.
source: Homebrew — custom infusion specific to Jaygar. Infuse Item itself is real Artificer (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything); this specific infusion is not.

name: Infusion: Perfume of Bewitching
description: Single-use vial. Apply as an action — for 1 hour the wearer has advantage on Charisma checks directed at humanoids of CR 1 or lower.
source: Homebrew — custom infusion specific to Jaygar. Infuse Item itself is real Artificer (Tasha's Cauldron of Everything); this specific infusion is not.

name: Keen Sight
description: The creature has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

name: Know Your Enemy
description: If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn whether it's your equal, superior, or inferior in two characteristics of your choice from the following: Strength score, Dexterity score, Constitution score, AC, current hit points, total class levels (if any), fighter class levels (if any).
note: Corrected 2026-09-09 -- previously said "one or more" characteristics; the real feature caps this at exactly two, chosen from the list.

name: Linked Spellbook
description: A yellow mark on the spine connects this spellbook permanently to two others. Any spell inscribed in any of the three books is instantly copied to the others. All three always share the same spell list.
source: Homebrew — bonded spellbook set unique to Lyria, Lenn, and Kessara.

name: Lucky
description: You have 3 luck points. Whenever you make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can spend one luck point to roll an additional d20, deciding after the original roll but before the outcome. You can choose which of the d20s is used. You can also spend a luck point when a creature makes an attack roll against you, rolling a d20 and choosing whether the attack uses its roll or yours. If two creatures each spend a luck point on the same roll, the points cancel out. Regain all spent luck points on a long rest.

name: Lucky (Halfling)
description: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
note: Halfling racial trait — distinct from, and easily confused with, the unrelated Lucky feat (pub_lucky): this is a passive reroll-on-a-1 that every Halfling has automatically, not an optional 3-point resource.

name: Metamagic Adept
description: You learn two Metamagic options of your choice from the sorcerer class. You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it, unless the option says otherwise. Whenever you reach a level that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace one of these Metamagic options with another one from the sorcerer class. You gain 2 sorcery points to spend on Metamagic (added to any sorcery points from another source, but usable only on Metamagic). You regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest.

name: Magical Tinkering
description: You've learned to invest a spark of magic into mundane objects. With thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand, touch a Tiny nonmagical object as an action and give it one of the following properties of your choice: it sheds bright light in a 5ft radius and dim light for an additional 5ft; it emits a recorded message up to 6 seconds long whenever tapped, audible up to 10ft away; it continuously emits a chosen odor or nonverbal sound, perceivable up to 10ft away; or a static visual effect (picture, up to 25 words of text, or shapes) appears on one of its surfaces. The chosen property lasts indefinitely — you can bestow a new property whenever you like, ending the previous one, and you can affect up to your Intelligence modifier's worth of objects (minimum one) at a time.

name: Mask of the Wild
description: Can attempt to hide even when only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, or other natural phenomena.

name: Mountain Born
description: You have resistance to cold damage. You're also acclimated to high altitude, including elevations above 20,000 feet.
source: Volo's Guide to Monsters / Player's Handbook (Goliath)

name: Naturally Stealthy
description: You can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

name: Parry
description: When another creature damages you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction and expend one superiority die to reduce the damage by the number you roll on the die + your Dexterity modifier.

name: Powerful Build
description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.
source: Volo's Guide to Monsters / Player's Handbook (Goliath)

name: Primal Strike
description: Your attacks in beast form (via Wild Shape) count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

name: Quickened Spell
description: Metamagic. When you cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, you can spend 2 sorcery points to change its casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

name: Resilient
description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency in saving throws using the chosen ability.

name: Rock Gnome Artificer's Lore
description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magical, alchemical, or technological items, you can add twice your proficiency bonus instead of any other proficiency bonus you may have.

name: Shelter of the Faithful
description: You command the respect of those who share your faith, and can perform the religious ceremonies of your deity. You and your companions can expect free healing and care at a temple, shrine, or other established presence of your faith, though you must provide any material components needed for spells. Those who share your religion support you (but only you) at a modest lifestyle. You have a residence at a specific temple, where you can call on the priests for assistance provided it isn't hazardous and you remain in good standing.

name: Spirit Session
description: Once per long rest, you can conduct an hour-long ritual channeling spirits through your Spiritual Focus with up to your proficiency bonus in other willing creatures. At the end of the ritual, you temporarily learn one Divination or Necromancy spell of your choice from any class — the spell's level can't exceed the number of creatures who took part and must be a level you can cast. The chosen spell counts as a bard spell for you but doesn't count against the number of bard spells you know.
source: College of Spirits (Bard subclass, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — 6th level, a separate feature from Spiritual Focus's own 6th-level damage/healing bonus roll (both genuinely trigger at 6th level).

name: Spiritual Focus
description: You can use a candle, crystal ball, skull, spirit board, or tarokka deck as a spellcasting focus for your bard spells. Starting at 6th level, whenever you cast a bard spell that deals damage or restores hit points through your Spiritual Focus, roll a d6 and add the result to one damage or healing roll of the spell.
source: College of Spirits (Bard subclass, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — 3rd level (focus) and 6th level (bonus roll).

name: Stars Druid — Star Map
description: You create a Tiny star chart (a scroll, stone tablet, bound maps, projecting crystal, glass disk, or similar) that serves as your spellcasting focus for druid spells. You learn the Guidance cantrip, and you have the Guiding Bolt spell prepared at all times — it doesn't count against your number of spells prepared, and you can cast it without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest. If you lose the map, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony during a short or long rest to magically create a replacement, destroying the old one.
source: Circle of the Stars (Druid subclass, Tasha's Cauldron of Everything) — 2nd level.
verification: CORRECTED 2026-09-10 — the previous description omitted the feature's entire mechanical payload (it only described the star chart as a vague spellcasting focus with hand-wavy "divinatory insight" flavor). Real RAW: it grants the Guidance cantrip and a free, always-prepared, slot-free-castable Guiding Bolt (proficiency bonus uses per long rest). Confirmed via two independent sources.
