name: Minor Alchemy
description: Spend 10 minutes to change one substance of a nonmagical object (up to 1 cubic foot) into another — wood, stone (not gemstones), iron, copper, or silver, any to any. The transformation lasts up to 1 hour (or until you use this again), reverting when it ends.
verification: Verified 2026-09-04 via WebSearch/WebFetch (dnd5e.wikidot.com) as part of building this subclass out from stub to a full 2/6/10/14 progression — added the real material list (wood/stone/iron/copper/silver) and the 10-minutes-per-cubic-foot working time.

name: Transmuter's Stone
description: Spend 8 hours to create a transmuter's stone (you can have only one at a time; anyone carrying it gets its benefit). Choose one benefit — changeable each time you cast a transmutation spell of 1st level or higher while it's on your person: darkvision out to 60ft; +10ft speed while unencumbered; proficiency in Constitution saves; or resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (choose the type each time).

name: Shapechanger
description: Add Polymorph to your spellbook for free if it isn't there already. You can cast it without a spell slot, targeting only yourself and transforming into a beast with challenge rating 1 or lower. Once used this way, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest (a normal spell slot works in the meantime).

name: Master Transmuter
description: As an action, consume your transmuter's stone entirely and choose one: Major Transformation (10 minutes' work to transmute one nonmagical object, no larger than a 5-foot cube, into another nonmagical object of similar size/mass and equal or lesser value); Panacea (touch a creature — remove all curses, diseases, and poisons affecting it, and it regains all hit points); Restore Life (cast Raise Dead on the touched creature, no slot or spell knowledge needed); or Restore Youth (touch a willing creature — its apparent age reduces by 3d10 years, minimum 13).

name: Arcane Deflection and Tactical Wit
description: Arcane Deflection: as a reaction when you're hit by an attack or fail a saving throw, gain a +2 bonus to your AC against that attack (potentially causing it to miss) or a +4 bonus to that save — at the cost of being unable to cast spells other than cantrips until the end of your next turn. Tactical Wit: add your Intelligence modifier to your initiative rolls.
verification: Verified 2026-09-04 via WebSearch/WebFetch (dnd5e.wikidot.com) as part of building this subclass out from stub to a full 2/6/10/14 progression — corrected Arcane Deflection's real cost (loses non-cantrip spellcasting until end of next turn, not attack-roll disadvantage).

name: Power Surge
description: Gain a pool of power surges, max equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) — gain one whenever you successfully counter or dispel a spell with Counterspell or Dispel Magic; a long rest resets your surges to 1 (not a full refill), and a short rest only grants 1 surge if you have zero. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with a wizard spell, spend one surge to deal extra force damage equal to half your wizard level.

name: Durable Magic
description: While concentrating on a spell, you have a +2 bonus to AC and to all saving throws.

name: Deflecting Shroud
description: Whenever you use Arcane Deflection, magical energy arcs from you — up to three creatures of your choice within 60ft each take force damage equal to half your wizard level.

name: Wizardly Quill and Awakened Spellbook
description: Wizardly Quill: bonus action to conjure a Tiny quill in your free hand — no ink needed (produces ink of your chosen color), and copying a spell into your spellbook with it takes 2 minutes per spell level instead of 2 hours. Dismiss it as a bonus action (no action needed); it also vanishes if you make another one or die. Awakened Spellbook: your spellbook is sentient and, while you hold it, serves as your spellcasting focus; when you cast a wizard spell with a slot, you can swap its acid/cold/fire/lightning/poison/thunder damage type for a different one of those types on another spell of the same level already in your spellbook; you can also cast its ritual spells at their normal casting time (no +10 minutes) once per long rest. If lost or destroyed, replace it during a short rest using the quill on a new blank spellbook.
verification: Verified 2026-09-04 via WebSearch/WebFetch (dnd5e.wikidot.com) as part of building this subclass out from stub to a full 2/6/10/14 progression — added the real quick-copy formula and the same-spell-level requirement on the damage-type swap.

name: Manifest Mind
description: As a bonus action, while your spellbook is on your person, manifest its mind as an intangible Tiny spectral object in an unoccupied space within 60ft — it sheds dim light in a 10ft radius, has 60ft darkvision, and shares what it senses with you telepathically. Move it up to 30ft (within 60ft of you) as a bonus action. You can cast spells as if you were in its space instead of your own, a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regained on a long rest (spending a spell slot also re-manifests it early). Ends if dismissed, if it goes beyond 300ft of you, is targeted by Dispel Magic, your spellbook is destroyed, or you die.

name: Master Scrivener
description: After a long rest, use the Wizardly Quill to inscribe a 1st- or 2nd-level spell from your spellbook (casting time of 1 action) onto blank paper as an enhanced scroll — it counts as one level higher for all purposes. Only you can cast it, as an action, by reading it; it's used up when cast or at your next long rest, whichever comes first. You can also craft ordinary spell scrolls with the quill at half the normal gold and time cost.

name: One with the Word
description: While your spellbook is on your person, you have advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks. If you take damage while your spellbook's mind is manifested (Manifest Mind), use your reaction to dismiss it and prevent all of that damage — roll 3d6, and your spellbook temporarily loses spells of your choice with a combined level equal to or greater than the roll (returning after you finish a number of long rests equal to 1d6). Usable once, regaining the ability to use it again on a long rest.
note: The exact fallback if your spellbook doesn't hold enough spell levels to cover the 3d6 roll wasn't pinned down to a verbatim source during research — worth a check against a physical/PDF TCE copy (p.116) if that edge case matters.

name: Actor
description: +1 CHA (max 20). Advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks when trying to pass yourself off as a different person. Can mimic the speech, accent, or sounds of a person/creature you've listened to for at least 1 minute (a listener who succeeds on a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by your Charisma (Deception) check can tell it's faked).

name: Alert
description: You can't be surprised while conscious. +5 bonus to initiative. Other creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls against you as a result of being unseen by you.

name: Athlete
description: +1 STR or DEX (max 20). Standing up from prone costs only 5ft of movement instead of half your speed. Climbing doesn't cost extra movement. You can make a running long or high jump after moving only 5ft, instead of 10ft.

name: Charger
description: When you use your action to Dash, you can use a bonus action to make one melee attack or to shove a creature. If you moved at least 10ft in a straight line immediately before that bonus action, you either gain a +5 bonus to the attack's damage roll (if it hits) or push the target up to 10ft away (if the shove succeeds).

name: Crossbow Expert
description: Ignore the loading property of crossbows you're proficient with. Being within 5ft of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls. When you use the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a hand crossbow you're holding.

name: Defensive Duelist
description: When wielding a finesse weapon you're proficient with and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC for that attack, potentially causing it to miss.

name: Dungeon Delver
description: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks to detect secret doors. Advantage on saving throws to avoid or resist traps. Resistance to damage dealt by traps. Traveling at a fast pace doesn't impose the normal -5 penalty on your passive Perception.

name: Durable
description: +1 CON (max 20). When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum you regain equals twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).

name: Grappler
description: Advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling. You can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by you — make another grapple check; if you succeed, you and the creature are both restrained until the grapple ends.

name: Healer
description: When you use a healer's kit to stabilize a dying creature, that creature also regains 1 hit point. As an action, spend one use of a healer's kit to tend a creature and restore 1d6+4 hit points plus additional hit points equal to its maximum Hit Dice; that creature can't benefit from this feat again until it finishes a short or long rest.

name: Heavily Armored
description: +1 STR (max 20). Gain proficiency with heavy armor.

name: Heavy Armor Master
description: +1 STR (max 20). While wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks is reduced by 3.

name: Keen Mind
description: +1 INT (max 20). You always know which way is north, the number of hours left before the next sunrise or sunset, and can accurately recall anything you've seen or heard within the past month.

name: Lightly Armored
description: +1 STR or DEX (max 20). Gain proficiency with light armor.

name: Linguist
description: +1 INT (max 20). Learn three languages of your choice. Can ably create written ciphers — others can't decipher them without your teaching, an Intelligence check (DC = your Intelligence score + proficiency bonus), or magic.

name: Mage Slayer
description: When a creature within 5ft casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it. When you damage a creature concentrating on a spell, it has disadvantage on the saving throw to maintain concentration. Advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5ft of you.

name: Magic Initiate
description: Choose bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard. Learn two cantrips of your choice from that class's spell list, plus one 1st-level spell from that list; you can cast the 1st-level spell once at its lowest level without a slot, regaining the ability on a long rest (it can also be cast normally with a spell slot). Spellcasting ability: Charisma (bard/sorcerer/warlock), Wisdom (cleric/druid), or Intelligence (wizard).

name: Martial Adept
description: Learn two maneuvers of your choice from the Battle Master fighter archetype (save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + STR or DEX modifier, your choice). Gain one superiority die (a d6), added to any you have from another source; it's expended when used and regained on a short or long rest.

name: Medium Armor Master
description: Wearing medium armor no longer imposes disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. When wearing medium armor, you can add 3 (instead of 2) to your AC if your Dexterity is 16 or higher.

name: Moderately Armored
description: +1 STR or DEX (max 20). Gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

name: Mounted Combatant
description: While mounted and not incapacitated: advantage on melee attack rolls against any unmounted creature smaller than your mount. You can force an attack targeted at your mount to target you instead. If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it a Dexterity save for half damage, it takes no damage on a success and only half on a failure.

name: Polearm Master
description: When you take the Attack action and attack with only a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon (d4 bludgeoning, using the same ability modifier). While wielding a glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff, or spear, other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter the reach you have with that weapon.

name: Ritual Caster
description: Gain a ritual book holding two 1st-level ritual-tagged spells of your choice from one class's spell list (bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard). Spellcasting ability depends on the class chosen: Charisma (bard/sorcerer/warlock), Wisdom (cleric/druid), or Intelligence (wizard). You can add further ritual spells you discover to the book if they're on your chosen class's list and no higher level than half your character level (rounded up); copying costs 2 hours and 50gp per spell level.

name: Savage Attacker
description: Once per turn, when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can reroll the weapon's damage dice and use either total.

name: Shield Master
description: If you take the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to shove a creature within 5ft with your shield. If not incapacitated, you can add your shield's AC bonus to any Dexterity save against a spell or effect that targets only you. As a reaction, if subjected to an effect that lets you make a Dexterity save for half damage, you can take no damage on a success by interposing your shield.

name: Skilled
description: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

name: Skulker
description: You can try to hide when only lightly obscured from the creature you're hiding from. Missing with a ranged weapon attack while hidden doesn't reveal your position. Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.

name: Spell Sniper
description: The range of spells you cast that require an attack roll is doubled. Your ranged spell attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover. Learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll, chosen from the bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list (spellcasting ability follows the list chosen).
prerequisite_note: The ability to cast at least one spell

name: Tavern Brawler
description: +1 STR or CON (max 20). Proficient with improvised weapons. Your unarmed strike uses a d4 for damage. When you hit with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to grapple the target.

name: Tough
description: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit points.

name: Elemental Adept
description: Choose a damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Spells you cast ignore resistance to damage of that type, and you can treat any 1 rolled on a damage die of that type as a 2. Can be selected multiple times, each time for a different damage type.
prerequisite_note: The ability to cast at least one spell

name: Weapon Master
description: +1 STR or DEX (max 20). Gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice, each a simple or martial weapon.

name: Artificer Initiate
description: Learn one cantrip and one 1st-level spell of your choice from the Artificer spell list (Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for them); the 1st-level spell can be cast once per long rest without expending a slot, and normally otherwise. Gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools, usable as a spellcasting focus for any Intelligence-based spell you cast.

name: Chef
description: +1 CON or WIS (max 20). Gain proficiency with cook's utensils if you don't have it. As part of a short rest (with ingredients and cook's utensils on hand), cook food for up to 4 + your proficiency bonus creatures — any of them who spend Hit Dice to heal at the end of that rest regain an extra 1d8 hit points. With 1 hour of work or on finishing a long rest, cook a number of treats equal to your proficiency bonus (usable within 8 hours); a creature can eat one as a bonus action to gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Crusher
description: +1 STR or CON (max 20). Once per turn, when you hit a creature no more than one size larger than you with bludgeoning damage, you can move it 5ft to an unoccupied space. When you score a critical hit that deals bludgeoning damage, attack rolls against that creature have advantage until the start of your next turn.

name: Eldritch Adept
description: Learn one Eldritch Invocation of your choice from the warlock class (choosing Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the ability tied to it; an invocation with its own prerequisites requires meeting them as if you were a warlock). Whenever you gain a level, you can swap the invocation for a different one from the warlock class.

name: Fighting Initiate
description: Learn one Fighting Style of your choice from the fighter class that you don't already have. Whenever you gain an Ability Score Improvement, you can swap it for a different fighter Fighting Style you don't know.

name: Gunner
description: +1 DEX (max 20). Gain proficiency with firearms. Ignore the loading property of firearms. Being within 5ft of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.

name: Piercer
description: +1 STR or DEX (max 20). Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a piercing-damage attack, you can reroll one of its damage dice and must use the new roll. On a critical hit that deals piercing damage, roll one additional damage die when determining the extra damage.

name: Poisoner
description: Ignore resistance to poison damage when you make a damage roll. Coating a weapon or piece of ammunition with poison takes a bonus action instead of an action. Gain proficiency with the poisoner's kit if you don't have it; with 1 hour and 50gp of materials, create a number of poison doses equal to your proficiency bonus. Applied poison keeps its potency for 1 minute or until you hit with the weapon/ammunition — a creature damaged by it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution save or take 2d8 poison damage and become poisoned until the end of your next turn.

name: Skill Expert
description: +1 to one ability score of your choice (max 20). Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. Choose one skill you're proficient in (that doesn't already have its proficiency bonus doubled by another feature) and gain Expertise in it, doubling your proficiency bonus for checks with it.

name: Telekinetic
description: +1 INT, WIS, or CHA (max 20). Learn the Mage Hand cantrip (castable without verbal or somatic components, its spectral hand can be made invisible; if you already knew it, its range increases by 30ft) — spellcasting ability is the one increased by this feat. As a bonus action, telekinetically shove one creature within 30ft: it must succeed on a Strength save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the increased ability's modifier) or be moved 5ft toward or away from you (a creature can willingly fail).

name: Telepathic
description: +1 INT, WIS, or CHA (max 20). Speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60ft, in a language you know (it understands only if it knows that language too; it can't reply telepathically). Cast Detect Thoughts once per long rest without a slot or components (spellcasting ability is the one increased by this feat); can also cast it normally with a 2nd-level+ slot.

name: Dragon Fear
description: +1 STR, CON, or CHA (max 20). Instead of a normal breath weapon use, you can roar: each creature within 30ft that can see or hear you must succeed on a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + CHA modifier) or become frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save when it takes damage.

name: Dragon Hide
description: +1 STR, CON, or CHA (max 20). While unarmored, your AC can be calculated as 13 + Dexterity modifier (a shield can still be used). Grow retractable claws usable as natural weapons — unarmed strikes with them deal 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing damage instead of the normal bludgeoning.

name: Drow High Magic
description: Cast Detect Magic at will, without a spell slot. Cast Levitate and Dispel Magic each once per long rest without a slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these.

name: Dwarven Fortitude
description: +1 CON (max 20). Whenever you take the Dodge action, you can spend one Hit Die to heal yourself — roll the die, add your Constitution modifier, and regain that many hit points.

name: Fey Teleportation
description: +1 INT or CHA (max 20). Learn to speak, read, and write Sylvan. Learn the Misty Step spell (Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it), castable once without a spell slot, regaining the ability on a short or long rest.

name: Flames of Phlegethos
description: +1 INT or CHA (max 20). When you roll fire damage for a spell you cast, you can reroll any 1s on the fire damage dice (must keep the new roll). Whenever you cast a spell that deals fire damage, you can wreathe yourself in harmless flames until the end of your next turn — they shed bright light 30ft/dim light 30ft further, and any creature within 5ft that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d4 fire damage.

name: Infernal Constitution
description: +1 CON (max 20). Resistance to cold and poison damage. Advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.

name: Orcish Fury
description: +1 STR or CON (max 20). When you hit with an attack using a simple or martial weapon, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice an extra time and add it as extra damage of the same type (once per short or long rest). Immediately after using Relentless Endurance, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack.

name: Prodigy
description: Gain one skill proficiency, one tool proficiency, and fluency in one language, all of your choice. Choose one skill you're already proficient in (that doesn't already have its proficiency bonus doubled by another feature) and gain Expertise in it.

name: Second Chance
description: +1 DEX, CON, or CHA (max 20). When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to force it to reroll. Usable again only after you roll initiative or finish a short or long rest.

name: Squat Nimbleness
description: +1 STR or DEX (max 20). +5ft walking speed. Gain proficiency in Acrobatics or Athletics (your choice). Advantage on Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks to escape a grapple.

name: Wood Elf Magic
description: Learn one druid cantrip of your choice. Learn the Longstrider and Pass without Trace spells, each castable once per long rest without a spell slot; Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

name: Commander's Strike
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your attacks and use a bonus action to direct a friendly creature to strike. That creature can use its reaction to make one weapon attack, adding the superiority die to the damage roll.

name: Distracting Strike
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the damage roll. Choose a creature within 5ft of the target other than yourself — that creature has advantage on its next attack roll against the target before the end of your next turn.

name: Evasive Footwork
description: When you move, you can expend one superiority die, adding it to your AC until you stop moving.

name: Feinting Attack
description: As a bonus action, expend one superiority die and feint against a creature within 5ft. You have advantage on your next attack roll against that creature this turn, and if it hits, add the superiority die to the damage roll.

name: Goading Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the damage roll. The target must make a Wisdom save (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + STR or DEX modifier) or have disadvantage on any attack roll against a target other than you until the end of your next turn.

name: Lunging Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you make a melee weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to increase your reach for that attack by 5ft; if it hits, add the die to the damage roll.

name: Maneuvering Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the damage roll. Then a friendly creature you can see can use its reaction to move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the target.

name: Pushing Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you hit a Large or smaller creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the damage roll. The target must make a STR save (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + STR or DEX modifier) or be pushed up to 15ft away.

name: Rally
description: As a bonus action, expend one superiority die and choose a friendly creature who can see or hear you. That creature gains temporary hit points equal to the die roll plus your Charisma modifier.

name: Sweeping Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to attempt to damage another creature within 5ft of the original target and within your reach. Roll the superiority die; if the original attack roll would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to the die roll (of the weapon's damage type).

name: Trip Attack
description: Expend one Superiority Die. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one superiority die to add it to the damage roll. The target must make a STR save (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + STR or DEX modifier) or be knocked prone.

name: Resilient (Constitution)
description: Increase Constitution by 1 (max 20) and gain proficiency in Constitution saving throws. (Legacy per-ability entry predating the generic "Resilient" feat entry above, kept so existing characters whose feature is literally named this way still resolve a description by name.)

name: Legendary Repertoire
description: Grants 3 additional cantrips known beyond the normal Druid cantrip cap for your level.
note: Homebrew, unique to Tackett — added 2026-09-08 to explain his 6 recorded cantrips against a Circle of Stars Druid 9's normal cap of 3, per the project owner's explicit call: Tackett is a "legendary" character and being RAW-cantrip-count-accurate isn't the goal here, a clean in-fiction reason to keep all 6 is. Not tied to any real class table — purely a flat +3.

name: Fighting Style: Blind Fighting
description: You have blindsight with a range of 10 feet. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind total cover, even if you're blinded or in darkness. Moreover, you can see an invisible creature within that range, unless the creature successfully hides from you.

name: Fighting Style: Interception
description: When a creature you can see hits a target, other than you, within 5 feet of you with an attack, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage the target takes by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus (to a minimum of 0). You must be wielding a shield or a simple or martial weapon to use this reaction.

name: Fighting Style: Superior Technique
source: Tasha's Cauldron of Everything — Fighter only.
description: You learn one maneuver of your choice from among those available to the Battle Master archetype. If a maneuver you use requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice). You gain one superiority die, a d6 (added to any superiority dice you have from another source), used to fuel that maneuver — expended when used, regained on finishing a short or long rest.

name: Fighting Style: Thrown Weapon Fighting
description: You can draw a weapon that has the thrown property as part of the attack you make with the weapon. In addition, when you hit with a ranged attack using a thrown weapon, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

name: Fighting Style: Unarmed Fighting
description: Your unarmed strikes can deal bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier on a hit (1d8 instead if you aren't wielding any weapon or shield when you make the attack roll). Additionally, when you use the Attack action on your turn to make an unarmed strike, you can make one extra unarmed strike as a bonus action — or attempt a grapple or shove instead, if you prefer.

name: Fighting Style: Blessed Warrior
source: Tasha's Cauldron of Everything — Paladin only.
description: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the cleric spell list. They count as paladin spells for you, and Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can replace one of these cantrips with another cantrip from the cleric spell list.

name: Fighting Style: Druidic Warrior
source: Tasha's Cauldron of Everything — Ranger only.
description: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the druid spell list. They count as ranger spells for you, and Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can replace one of these cantrips with another cantrip from the druid spell list.
